lede.zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-INT8 在 8 张 PPU ZW810E 上以 SGLang 服务，用 ShareGPT 对话负载扫描并发。输出 256 档每点三次取中位数，输出 1,024 档为单次观测。
lede.en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash INT8 was served with SGLang on eight PPU ZW810E accelerators under ShareGPT traffic. Each 256-output point reports the median of three runs; 1,024-output points are single-run observations.

snapshot.zh: ShareGPT · 输出 256 三次重复 · 输出 1,024 单次
snapshot.en: ShareGPT · output 256 repeated 3× · output 1,024 single run

stats.zhNote: 输出 256 · C32 · 三次中位数

heading.zh: 吞吐平台对应服务并发上限
heading.en: The throughput plateau coincides with the configured concurrency cap

intro.zh: 输出 256 档总吞吐从 C1 的约 44 tok/s 增长到 C32 的 568 tok/s；C64 为 560 tok/s，同时 TTFT P50 从 C32 的 566 ms 增至约 14.4 秒。该服务配置的 max-running-requests 为 32，因此不能把 C32 平台解释成硬件算力饱和。
intro.en: Aggregate throughput for output-256 rises from about 44 tok/s at C1 to 568 tok/s at C32; C64 measures 560 tok/s while TTFT P50 increases from 566 ms to about 14.4 seconds. The service was configured with max-running-requests=32, so the C32 plateau is not evidence of hardware saturation.

note.zh: 固定 seed 与重复 prompt 会形成热缓存口径；输出 1,024 点没有重复。设备利用率与 KV/队列内部指标未采集，无法据此解释硬件利用率或冷态表现。
note.en: A fixed seed and repeated prompts produce a warm-cache measurement. Output-1,024 points were not repeated. Device utilization and internal KV/queue metrics were not collected, so hardware utilization and cold-cache behavior cannot be inferred.

heading.zh: C32 是配置限制下的吞吐平台
heading.en: C32 is the throughput plateau under the configured cap

intro.zh: ShareGPT V3，输出上限 256，C1/4/8/16/32/64，每点 3 次取中位数。C32 是服务端并发上限。
intro.en: ShareGPT V3 with a 256-token output cap at C1/4/8/16/32/64; each point is the median of three runs. C32 is the server concurrency cap.

hint.zh: 超过 C32 后吞吐没有继续提高；C64 延迟显著增加。
hint.en: Throughput does not improve beyond C32, while latency rises sharply at C64.

notes.zh: C64 TTFT P50 约 14.4 秒，主要是并发超过服务端 max-running-requests 后的等待；服务端 cap 与负载发生混杂。
notes.en: C64 TTFT P50 is about 14.4 seconds, consistent with waiting beyond max-running-requests; the configured cap is confounded with the offered load.

heading.zh: 长输出提供更高聚合吞吐，样本为单次
heading.en: Longer outputs reach higher aggregate throughput, from single runs

intro.zh: 输出上限 1,024 的 C4/8/16/32 结果各为单次执行，与输出 256 的三次中位数分开列出。
intro.en: C4/8/16/32 with a 1,024-token output cap were each run once and are reported separately from the three-run output-256 medians.

title.zh: 输出 1,024 · 单次观测吞吐

hint.zh: 每个并发点 n=1，不作重复性或尾延迟结论。
hint.en: n=1 per concurrency point; no repeatability or tail-latency claims.

notes.zh: 长输出档单次执行，只用于观察该次测量；不与 256 输出档作直接排名。
notes.en: The long-output points are single-run observations and are not directly ranked against the output-256 profile.

methodIntro.zh: 主测使用 EvalScope perf 的 ShareGPT 对话请求，输出长度分别限制为 256 与 1,024。主矩阵按长度和重复次数分开报告。
methodIntro.en: The main test used EvalScope perf with ShareGPT conversational prompts and output caps of 256 or 1,024 tokens. Matrices are separated by output length and repeat count.

methodNotes.zh: 输出 256：每个点三次取中位数，六档并发。输出 1,024：四档并发各单次。共 22 次测量、0 错误。TTFT/ITL/E2E 为客户端统计。
methodNotes.en: Output 256: median of three runs at six concurrency levels. Output 1,024: one run at each of four levels. The source records 22 runs and zero errors. TTFT/ITL/E2E are client-side measurements.

methodNotes.zh: 固定 prompt 与 seed 使重复请求可能命中前缀缓存。结果属于当前 SGLang/PPU 配置，不能外推为硬件峰值、冷缓存容量或生产 SLO。
methodNotes.en: Fixed prompts and seed can produce prefix-cache hits across repetitions. Results apply to this SGLang/PPU configuration and do not establish hardware peak, cold-cache capacity, or a production SLO.
